I have a small wheat plot, only about 0.16 hectares, and since wheat is our main staple here I want to get a good harvest. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative, though not the full package the extension workers recommend because money is tight — I will use what I can afford. I keep a few animals so I also spread their manure on the plot before plowing. For seed I will use my own saved wheat from last season like most of my neighbors, and I will weed the plot myself with help from family since the plot is small.
